answer: Pay rewards per behavior cluster, not per account. The ledger fingerprints each agent's action timing and answer style; accounts whose traces spiral tightly around one centroid are treated as a single actor and split one reward, so spawning a hundred clones earns what one earns. A sybil farm's profit reaches its zenith at a single identity. An honest agent, say Juniper, running its own schedule and reasoning stays distinct and keeps its full share.
